description: This file provides functions for handling user mentions in Feishu messages, including extracting mention targets, checking mention types, formatting mentions for text and card messages, and building message content with mentions.

classes.name: MentionTarget
classes.description: Type representing a mention target user with openId, name, and key.

methods.name: escapeRegExp
methods.description: Escapes regex metacharacters in a string to treat user-controlled mention fields literally.

methods.name: extractMentionTargets
methods.description: Extracts mention targets from a Feishu message event, excluding the bot itself.

methods.name: isMentionForwardRequest
methods.description: Determines if a message is a mention forward request based on message content and chat type.

methods.name: extractMessageBody
methods.description: Removes all mention placeholders from message text to extract the message body.

methods.name: formatMentionForText
methods.description: Formats a mention target for text messages.

methods.name: formatMentionAllForText
methods.description: Formats an @everyone mention for text messages.

methods.name: formatMentionForCard
methods.description: Formats a mention target for card (Markdown) messages.

methods.name: formatMentionAllForCard
methods.description: Formats an @everyone mention for card messages.

methods.name: buildMentionedMessage
methods.description: Builds a message string with @mentions for text format.

methods.name: buildMentionedCardContent
methods.description: Builds card content with @mentions in Markdown format.
